business_problem: Rahul Khanna, Senior Engineering Manager of Data Engineering at Tata 1mg, explained, “While our legacy architecture served its purpose, relying on truncate-and-reload tables made transformations costly and time-consuming.
solution_summary: Committed to breaking down barriers to healthcare, Tata 1mg offers a diverse range of services, catering to millions of Indian customers online, in person and through delivery. This initiative relies on data from various sources, including customers, physical locations, traffic and weather patterns and purchasing information. Accounting for the impact of these factors is essential for Tata 1mg to enhance personalization, customer experiences, onsite assessments, real-time deliveries and supply chain efficiency. As features available in Databricks looked promising and cost-efficient, the team grew excited to leverage the platform to uncover new use cases.
business_outcome: Tata 1mg achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 50% reduction in ETL costs since migrating to Databricks; 1,000+ non-data team business users accessing Databricks insights; Serving 220 million customers across India in 27,000+ pin code markets, Tata 1mg had relatively higher cost solutions implemented for managing their data stack..
metrics: 50% reduction in ETL costs since migrating to Databricks
1,000+ non-data team business users accessing Databricks insights
Serving 220 million customers across India in 27,000+ pin code markets, Tata 1mg had relatively higher cost solutions implemented for managing their data stack.
After transitioning from their data warehouse and optimizing data processing with automated Databricks components, Tata 1mg reduced extract, transform, load (ETL) costs by 50%.
Hundreds of business use cases are in production, over 1,000 reports are generated and more than 1,000 users consume these insights, embedding a data-driven culture across all business lines.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Provides access control, governance, and lineage across Tata 1mg's shared data products and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores Tata 1mg's curated datasets for analytics, machine learning, and operational use cases.

solution_components.name: Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines
solution_components.role: Runs declarative transformations that prepare source data for production analytics and AI.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares curated datasets with partners, customers, or internal domains without copying data.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks and is transformed through managed pipelines stored in Delta Lake under Unity Catalog governance before being served through Delta Sharing
